name: Path of the Berserker
summary: A barbarian who channels rage into pure violence, at a cost to their body.

features.name: Frenzy
features.short: While raging, attack again as a bonus action; exhaustion after.
features.summary: When you rage, you can go into a frenzy. For the rage's duration you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns. When the rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.short: Can't be charmed or frightened while raging.
features.summary: You can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the rage's duration.

grants.text: While raging: immune to charmed and frightened.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.short: Action: frighten a creature with your menace.
features.summary: As an action, you frighten a creature within 30 ft. that can see or hear you (WIS save, DC 8 + PB + CHA). You can extend the effect with your action on later turns. Once it saves, it is immune for 24 hours.

features.name: Retaliation
features.short: Reaction: hit back when a nearby creature damages you.
features.summary: When you take damage from a creature within 5 ft. of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.
